newsitem.title: USA: U.S. to sell $26 billion of 3-, 6-mo bills Dec 16.
newsitem.headline: U.S. to sell $26 billion of 3-, 6-mo bills Dec 16.

text.p: The Treasury Department said Tuesday it would auction $26 billion of three- and six-month bills on December 16 to pay down $28.925 billion, as $54.919 billion of bills are maturing.
The maturing total includes $17.048 billion of 48-day cash bills issued November 1 and $13.217 billion of 34-day bills issued on November 15.
The weekly bill sale will be equally divided between the two maturities. The bills will be issued December 19. The three-month bills mature on March 20 and the six-month bills mature on June 19.
The CUSIP number for the three-month bills is 9127944C5, and for the six-month bills is 9127944N1.
